verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on checkpointing or persisting agent or crew state so a run can recover after a crash or restart. Flows are described only as managing and sharing state between tasks. The Memory system covers semantic recall, not execution checkpoints. The AMP POST /resume endpoint resumes execution only after human feedback, not crash recovery. A competitor's comment that CrewAI lacks persistent states is consistent with this absence, though it is not independent verification.
